## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the plastic soda bottle from the table head-up.

Task description: Pick up the plastic soda bottle lying horizontally on the table and turn it so the opening faces upward. In this round, the cap faces left in the image, the base faces right, and the target is above the tabletop to the right of center.

Success criteria: Move the bottle to an outer position right of the table center and lift it clearly above the table, mouth-up. Merely straightening it near tabletop level is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the relatively flat bottle body near the red label, avoiding the narrow neck and uneven base. Orient the gripper’s closing direction as close to perpendicular to the long axis as possible to reduce slipping.
- Use smaller movements while approaching the bottle. Use both the overhead and wrist cameras to confirm that the selected area is between the fingers before closing, avoiding an empty grasp or pushing the bottle away.
- First make a small lift and observe whether the bottle follows the gripper. Then adjust its orientation where there is clearance from the table and nearby objects, reducing the risk of sweeping the base across the table.
